# Emoji Metadata Dataset


[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%93%A6-GitHub%20-black.svg)](https://github.com/badrex/emojeez) 
[![Huggingface Space](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%92%8E-Demo%20-blue.svg)](https://huggingface.co/spaces/badrex/emojeez-semantic-emoji-search)


## Overview

The LLM Emoji Dataset is a comprehensive collection of enriched semantic descriptions for emojis, generated using Meta AI's Llama-3-8B model. This dataset aims to provide semantic context for each emoji, enhancing their usability in various NLP applications, especially those requiring semantic search. The LLM Emoji Dataset was used to build a multilingual search engine for emojies, which you can interact with using this online Streamlit demo [Emojeez 💎](https://emojeez.streamlit.app/).

For more info, check out this GitHub [repo](https://github.com/badrex/emojeez).

## Dataset Structure

The dataset contains the following fields:

- `character`: The emoji character.
- `unicode`: The Unicode representation of the emoji.
- `short description`: A brief description of the emoji (standard Unicode).
- `tags`: Relevant tags associated with the emoji.
- `LLM description`: A rich, detailed description of the emoji generated by the LLM.

## Example

Here is a sample entry from the dataset:

```json
{
"character": "🥇",
"unicode": "U+1F947",
"short description": "1ST PLACE MEDAL",
"tags": ["first place", "victory", "achievement", "success", "competition", "winner", "award"],
"LLM description": "This emoji represents a first place medal, often used to symbolize victory, achievement, and being the best in a competition or event."
}
